channel.title: Western Sahara - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Western Sahara, every source cited.

item.title: UN confirms liquidation of Western Sahara mission
item.description: The 35-year-old UN mission for organising a referendum in Western Sahara has ended after its mandate was not renewed.

item.title: Russia vetoes US draft on Western Sahara
item.description: UN mission's mandate extended to October 31, 2026, without name change.
